title: CO.STARTERS Canvas Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Entrepreneurship
description: A clickable map of the 11-block CO.STARTERS Canvas, filled in with Jordan's Session 1 answers for a mobile dog-grooming idea. Selecting a block shows its guiding question, a one-sentence definition, Jordan's example answer, and the chapter that covers it in depth; a toggle writes every answer inside the grid.

prerequisites: Chapter 1: Entrepreneurship, Lean Thinking & the Idea Trap
educational.topic: The 11 blocks of the CO.STARTERS Canvas
learningObjectives: Explain the guiding question each of the 11 CO.STARTERS Canvas blocks answers
Locate a worked example answer for each block on Jordan's Session 1 canvas

controls.label: Canvas blocks
controls.purpose: Select one of the 11 blocks to show its question, definition, Jordan's answer, and chapter

controls.label: Previous
controls.purpose: Select the previous block in canvas order (also the left arrow key)

controls.label: Next
controls.purpose: Select the next block in canvas order (also the right arrow key)

controls.label: Show All Answers / Hide All Answers
controls.purpose: Toggle Jordan's short answer inside every block of the grid

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Guided exploration of a static, clickable diagram with a concrete worked example
keyQuestions: What question does this block answer?
How does Jordan's answer in this block support the blocks next to it?
commonMisconceptions: The 11 blocks are separate homework questions rather than one connected argument
Benefit and Advantage mean the same thing
Startup Needs and Costs are both ongoing expenses
assessmentOpportunities: State the guiding question for any block without clicking it
Name the block that a given one of Jordan's answers belongs to
